relationships.subject: TH1020
relationships.evidence_quote: The inhibition of mechanical allodynia induced by QX-314 alone was blocked by intraplantar injection of a TLR5 antagonist TH1020

relationships.subject: TLR5
relationships.evidence_quote: mechanical allodynia due to TNX deficiency is caused by the hypersensitivity of Aδ- and Aβ-fibers, and it is induced by constitutive activation of TLR5

relationships.subject: QX-314
relationships.evidence_quote: Interestingly, QX-314 alone inhibited the mechanical allodynia

key_findings: Tnxb-/- mice show Aδ/Aβ-fiber hypersensitivity with constitutive TLR5 activation driving mechanical allodynia.
